verdicts.sentence: The **interdependency graph** (introduced by Buldyrev et al., 2010) models mutual dependencies between cyber and physical subgraphs and shows that interdependency drastically increases fragility — coupled networks can suffer abrupt, first-order phase transitions in connectivity at failure thresholds far below what either network would exhibit alone.
verdicts.corrected: The **interdependency graph** (introduced by Buldyrev et al., 2010, doi:10.1038/nature08932) models mutual dependencies between cyber and physical subgraphs and shows that interdependency drastically increases fragility — coupled networks can suffer abrupt, first-order phase transitions in connectivity at failure thresholds far below what either network would exhibit alone.
